pairs.target: sè lā lái guò yǐhòu , tǎ wéi yòu guò le shíèrtiān .
pairs.english: Twelve more days passed for Tavi after Sela's visit.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉来过以后，塔维又过了十二天。

pairs.target: tā bǎ nà tuán xiàn fēn le yíbàn gěi pà wò , zìjǐ de xiùkǒu yě chóngxīn fènghǎo .
pairs.english: He gave half the thread to Pavo and sewed his own cuff again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把那团线分了一半给帕沃，自己的袖口也重新缝好。

pairs.target: liànxí méiyǒu yīnwèi jiālǐrén kànguò jiù hūrán shùnlì :
pairs.english: Practice did not suddenly become smooth because his family had visited.
pairs.hanzi: 练习没有因为家里人看过就忽然顺利：

pairs.target: yǒu yícì táishǒu tài jí , liǎngbiān méi děng wěnbiàn sàn le ; lìng yícì zhǐ bèi pèng wāi , luò héng ràng tā zhòngdú yuánlái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Once he lifted his hands too hastily and both sides faded before settling; another time the paper was knocked crooked, and Lohen made him read the starting positions again.
pairs.hanzi: 有一次抬手太急，两边没等稳便散了；另一次纸被碰歪，洛衡让他重读原来的位置。

pairs.target: yě yǒu liǎnghuí cóngtóudàowěi dōu zuò wán , shōu dōngxī shí shuí yě méi tèbié shuō shénme .
pairs.english: There were also two times he completed everything, and nobody remarked on it while packing up.
pairs.hanzi: 也有两回从头到尾都做完，收东西时谁也没特别说什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fǎnér jìde nà liǎnghuí , xiàng zhōngyú néng bǎ yìwǎnshuǐ duān dào zhuōshàng , búbì měi yíbù dōu xiǎngzhuó shǒulǐ de wǎn .
pairs.english: Those were the times Tavi remembered: like finally carrying a bowl of water to the table without thinking about the bowl at every step.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维反而记得那两回，像终于能把一碗水端到桌上，不必每一步都想着手里的碗。

pairs.target: jiǎnchá nàtiān , zhuōshàng de liǎngpiàn tiě bù yíyàng kuān .
pairs.english: On assessment day, the two iron strips on the table had different widths.
pairs.hanzi: 检查那天，桌上的两片铁不一样宽。

pairs.target: tā xiān yǐwéi ná cuò le .
pairs.english: At first he thought they had brought the wrong ones.
pairs.hanzi: 他先以为拿错了。

alignment.english: they had brought the wrong ones

pairs.target: zuǒbiān kuān ér báo , yòubiān zhǎi xiē , hòu xiē , chángdù xiāngjìn , pèng shǒu de dìfāng dōu mó dé gānjìng .
pairs.english: The left was broad and thin, the right narrower and thicker. Their lengths were similar, and the contact areas had been polished clean.
pairs.hanzi: 左边宽而薄，右边窄些、厚些，长度相近，碰手的地方都磨得干净。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ jìlù yè dìgěi tā , shuō jīntiān réng shì jiēchù liànxí , bú zuò lí shǒu liú xiào .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey gave him the record sheet, saying today was still contact practice, with no hands-free residue.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把记录页递给他，说今天仍是接触练习，不做离手留效。

pairs.target: luò héng jì dìyīlún , suíhòu huànrén .
pairs.english: Lohen would record the first round, then they would switch.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡记第一轮，随后换人。

pairs.target: zhècì jiǎnchá juédìng xiàzhōu wàichū kè gèzì néng zuò shénme , bú dòng tāmen yǐjīng qiānhǎo de zhùxué tiáokuǎn .
pairs.english: This check determined their roles on next week's outing, not their already signed funding terms.
pairs.hanzi: 这次检查决定下周外出课各自能做什么，不动他们已经签好的助学条款。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ liǎngpiàn bìngpái kàn le yíhuìer , ná qǐ liáng chǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi studied the strips side by side, then picked up a ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把两片并排看了一会儿，拿起量尺。

pairs.target: liáng dào báopiàn hòudù shí , tā bùgǎn píng yǎnjīng zài liǎnggè kèdù zhījiān cāi , huàn le xì liángjù , yòu jiào lǎoshī kàn zìjǐ fàng dé duì bu duì .
pairs.english: Measuring the thin strip's thickness, he would not guess between marks by eye; he changed to a finer gauge and asked the instructor to check its placement.
pairs.hanzi: 量到薄片厚度时，他不敢凭眼睛在两个刻度之间猜，换了细量具，又叫老师看自己放得对不对。

pairs.target: luò héng yǐjīng xiě le kuānzhǎi liǎnggè zì , jiàn tā liáng le dìsān chù , biàn tíngbǐ děng zhe .
pairs.english: Lohen had already written “broad” and “narrow.” Seeing him measure a third dimension, he stopped his pen to wait.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡已经写了宽窄两个字，见他量了第三处，便停笔等着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shùmù chéng chūlái , dìyīcì mòwěi duō xiě le yíwèi , suàn wán zìjǐ juéde bú duì , chóngxīn pái le yìháng .
pairs.english: Tavi multiplied the figures, adding an extra digit at first, then sensed something wrong in the result and wrote a fresh row.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把数目乘出来，第一次末尾多写了一位，算完自己觉得不对，重新排了一行。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng liǎngtuán shùzì zhōngyú yíyàng , tiěpiàn kànqǐlái què réng bú xiàng yíduì .
pairs.english: The two sets of figures finally matched, but the strips still did not look like a pair.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上两团数字终于一样，铁片看起来却仍不像一对。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ tuīguòqù , shuō zhěngpiàn de tǐjī xiāngtóng , bù děngyú guà shàng tóngyàng dōngxī huì wān dé yíyàng .
pairs.english: He pushed the paper over and said equal whole volumes did not mean equal bending under equal loads.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸推过去，说整片的体积相同，不等于挂上同样东西会弯得一样。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā jiēzhe zuò .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey told him to continue.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他接着做。

pairs.target: xiǎo fǎmǎ guàshàngqù , kuān báo de nà piàn xiàchén dé duō , lìng yípiàn zhī piān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: With the little weights hung, the broad thin strip sank farther; the other shifted only slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 小砝码挂上去，宽薄的那片下沉得多，另一片只偏了一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de yǎnjīng hěn xiǎng bǎ liǎngbiān kànqí , shǒu hái méi shēnchū , xiān yòngbǐ zài gèzì pángbiān jì le yuánlái de xiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi's eyes wanted to align the two sides. Before reaching out, he marked each starting position with his pen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的眼睛很想把两边看齐，手还没伸出，先用笔在各自旁边记了原来的线。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ chūxué shí zǒng juéde wāi le jiùyào fú , hòulái cái zhīdào zìjǐ yǒushí fú diào de zhèngshì yào kàn de dōngxī .
pairs.english: He remembered always wanting to straighten anything crooked when he began, only later realizing that sometimes he straightened away what he needed to observe.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起初学时总觉得歪了就要扶，后来才知道自己有时扶掉的正是要看的东西。

pairs.target: luò héng fǔshēn huàn zhǐbǎn , zhuōmiàn qīngqīng zhèn le yíxià .
pairs.english: Lohen bent to change the card, making the table tremble slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡俯身换纸板，桌面轻轻震了一下。

pairs.target: yòubiān de jiājù wǎng wài nuó le bàndiǎn , yuánlái de xiàn yě gēnzhe biàn .
pairs.english: The right fixture shifted outward a fraction, taking the starting line with it.
pairs.hanzi: 右边的夹具往外挪了半点，原来的线也跟着变。

alignment.english: taking the starting line with it

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiào tā xiān tíng , bǎ lǎoshī qǐng guòlái . búshì tiě zài biànruǎn , shì dǐxià de mùxiē méiyǒu yāshí .
pairs.english: Tavi asked him to stop and called the instructor over. The iron was not softening; the wooden wedge underneath was loose.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维叫他先停，把老师请过来。不是铁在变软，是底下的木楔没有压实。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng liǎng rén xièxià fǎmǎ , chóngxīn gùdìng , zài cóngtóu dú .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey had them remove the weights, fix it again, and start the readings over.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让两人卸下砝码，重新固定，再从头读。

pairs.target: děng zuòhǎo , tǎ wéi zhǎngxīn yǐjīng nuǎn le .
pairs.english: By the time everything was ready, Tavi's palms were warm.
pairs.hanzi: 等做好，塔维掌心已经暖了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngshǒu fàngshàngqù , xiān zhǎodào shúxī de qiānchě , suíhòu cái mànmàn gǎibiàn liǎngbiān de shùnfú chéngdù .
pairs.english: He placed both hands on the strips, first finding the familiar pull before slowly changing their yielding response.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两手放上去，先找到熟悉的牵扯，随后才慢慢改变两边的顺服程度。

alignment.english: placed both hands on the strips

pairs.target: kuān báo de yícè jìnyíbù chuí xià , zhǎi hòu de yícè wǎnghuí tái , zǒu de jùlí bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: The broad thin side sank farther, while the narrow thick one rose back, moving different distances.
pairs.hanzi: 宽薄的一侧进一步垂下，窄厚的一侧往回抬，走的距离不一样。

pairs.target: tā chàyìdiǎn zhuī zhe jiào xiǎo de nàbiān duō yònglì , mùguāng pèngdào zìjǐ xiěxià de qǐdiǎn , biàn tíng zài yuánlái de dǎsuàn shàng .
pairs.english: He almost pushed harder in pursuit of the smaller movement, but seeing his marked starting points, stayed with his original intention.
pairs.hanzi: 他差一点追着较小的那边多用力，目光碰到自己写下的起点，便停在原来的打算上。

pairs.target: lǎoshī qiāo le yíxià zhuōmiàn , tā jiéshù jiēchù . liǎngpiàn huídào gèzì yuánchù , méiyǒu biànchéng yìbān gāo .
pairs.english: The instructor tapped the table once, and he ended contact. The strips returned to their own positions, not to the same height.
pairs.hanzi: 老师敲了一下桌面，他结束接触。两片回到各自原处，没有变成一般高。

pairs.target: luò héng dītóu jì wán , shuō chàdiǎn xiǎng wèn shìbushì méi huīfù .
pairs.english: After recording, Lohen said he had almost asked whether they had failed to recover.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡低头记完，说差点想问是不是没恢复。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě chéngrèn zìjǐ chàdiǎn xiǎng ràng tāmen qí yìdiǎn . liǎng rén kànzhe zhuōshàng nà yìgāoyìdī , hūrán xiào le , xiàng bèi tóngyígè hěn bèn de xiàohuà piàn le liǎnghuí .
pairs.english: Tavi admitted nearly wanting to level them. Looking at their unequal heights, they laughed, as if fooled twice by the same silly joke.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也承认自己差点想让它们齐一点。两人看着桌上那一高一低，忽然笑了，像被同一个很笨的笑话骗了两回。

pairs.target: hēshuǐ xiūxi yǐhòu , tāmen bǎ zuǒyòu wèizhì huànguòlái , zài zuò yícì .
pairs.english: After water and a rest, they swapped the left and right positions and repeated the trial.
pairs.hanzi: 喝水休息以后，他们把左右位置换过来，再做一次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèhuí xiān kàn jiājù , zài kàn fǎmǎ , zuìhòu cái fàngshǒu .
pairs.english: This time Tavi checked the fixture first, then the weights, before placing his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这回先看夹具，再看砝码，最后才放手。

pairs.target: duǎnduǎnde yícì biànhuà jiéshù , luò héng bàochū dúshù , wéi lǎoshī zài liǎngzhāng jìlù shàng gè diǎn le yíxià , méiyǒu ràng tā jiā zuò dìsānlún .
pairs.english: After the brief change ended, Lohen gave the readings. Instructor Vey touched each record and did not ask for a third trial.
pairs.hanzi: 短短的一次变化结束，洛衡报出读数，维老师在两张记录上各点了一下，没有让他加做第三轮。

pairs.target: jiǎnchá wán , tǎ wéi zài ménwài děng luò héng .
pairs.english: After his check, Tavi waited outside for Lohen.
pairs.hanzi: 检查完，塔维在门外等洛衡。

pairs.target: lún dào luò héng shí , tā bǎ shù xiě dé hěnkuài , dòngzuò què bǐ tǎ wéi màn ;
pairs.english: When Lohen's turn came, he wrote his numbers quickly but moved more slowly than Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到洛衡时，他把数写得很快，动作却比塔维慢；

pairs.target: chūlái yǐhòu dìyījù huà búshì wèn shuí gènghǎo , érshì shuō zìjǐ zuǒshǒu bèi dèng yán gè le yíxià , xiàcì dé bǎ yǐzi nuókāi .
pairs.english: On coming out he did not first ask who was better, but said the stool edge had pressed into his left hand; next time he needed to move the chair.
pairs.hanzi: 出来以后第一句话不是问谁更好，而是说自己左手被凳沿硌了一下，下次得把椅子挪开。

pairs.target: wǔhòu fēnzǔ tiēchūlái , tǎ wéi de míngzì zài jìnlù cèliáng zǔ .
pairs.english: The groups were posted that afternoon. Tavi was in the nearby-route measurement group.
pairs.hanzi: 午后分组贴出来，塔维的名字在近路测量组。

pairs.target: wǔtiān hòu chū chéng , yán yǐjīng kāifàng de yìlù zǒu dào lǐng biān de jiù hòuchē péng , dāngtiān huílái .
pairs.english: They would leave the city in five days, follow an open post road to the old waiting shelter at the ridge, and return the same day.
pairs.hanzi: 五天后出城，沿已经开放的驿路走到岭边的旧候车棚，当天回来。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī lǐngduì , wéi lǎoshī dài liángjù zǔ , mǐlā hé yīwén zuò lùxiàn yǔ gòujiàn jìlù .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian would lead, Instructor Vey would oversee instruments, and Mira and Iven would record routes and structural parts.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师领队，维老师带量具组，米拉和伊文做路线与构件记录。

pairs.target: dé mǎ zài xià yìzǔ , chūfā shíchén bùtóng , shào lǐ zé xiézhù bān qìcái , búshì dài tāmen qù màoxiǎn de lǐngduì .
pairs.english: Dema would go in the next group at a different time. Shaoli would help carry equipment, not lead them on an adventure.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛在下一组，出发时辰不同，邵里则协助搬器材，不是带他们去冒险的领队。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóngtóu dú le liǎngbiàn , cái qù zhǎo nài lěi .
pairs.english: Tavi read it twice before finding Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从头读了两遍，才去找奈蕾。

pairs.target: tā kàn wán nà zhāng chāoxiàlái de ānpái , shuō zìjǐ nàtiān yě zài fùjìn hé yíduàn lùbiāo , dàgài néng zài péng biān pèngjiàn .
pairs.english: She read his copied schedule and said she would be checking nearby route markers that day and might meet them at the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 她看完那张抄下来的安排，说自己那天也在附近核一段路标，大概能在棚边碰见。

pairs.target: tā běnlái hái xiǎng wèn tā néng bunéng yìqǐ zǒu , tīngjiàn dàgài , biàn bǎ nàge wèntí shōuhuí qù , gǎi wèn lùshang néng kànjiàn hé ma .
pairs.english: He had wanted to ask if she could walk with them, but hearing “might,” held back that question and asked whether he could see the river on the way instead.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来还想问她能不能一起走，听见大概，便把那个问题收回去，改问路上能看见河吗。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō kàn yún . yǒushí yún bǎ hé gài dé yányánshíshí , yǒushí yòu lùchū lái , gēn wūlǐ de tú bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Nerai said it depended on clouds. Sometimes they covered the river completely; sometimes it appeared, unlike a map indoors.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说看云。有时云把河盖得严严实实，有时又露出来，跟屋里的图不一样。

pairs.target: huí qǐnshì shí , tǎ wéi bǎ míngdān zhé hǎo , fàngzài méiyǒu huíxìn de yú wān zhǐ páng .
pairs.english: Back in his room, Tavi folded the list and put it beside the Elmbay paper, still without a reply.
pairs.hanzi: 回寝室时，塔维把名单折好，放在没有回信的榆湾纸旁。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zài suàn xìn zǒu le jǐtiān , xiān fān chū yào dài de wàzi , bǎ jiǎogēn shàng yíchù báo le de dìfāng jǔ dào dēng qián .
pairs.english: He did not count the days the letter had traveled again. Instead he found the socks he would take and held a worn patch on one heel toward the lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有再算信走了几天，先翻出要带的袜子，把脚跟上一处薄了的地方举到灯前。
